decision: 5 second time penalty (2 penalty points awarded, 5 points in total for the 12 month period)
event_name: Williams Martini Racing Document 45 Date 24 June 2018 Time 17:20 2018 FRENCH GRAND PRIX 21 - 24 June 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 35 drove unnecessarily slowly behind the safety car.
offence: Breach of Article 39.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video, team radio communications and GPS data. Car 35 was instructed to stack behind Car 18 and to go "plus 8". The driver of Car 35 then slowed significantly creating a large gap behind Car 18, by driving unnecessarily slowly. All Competitors are hereby reminded of their right to appeal certain
rules_referenced: Article 39.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: as set out in the International Sporting Code
